title: 🚨 The Stock Market Is Falling - What You Need To Do!
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Markets jumped on a reported US-Iran peace deal that appears false; risk of bull traps before big earnings.

calls.reason: Markets technically oversold at strong 700 support; dip-buying makes sense, but warns of bull trap if SpaceX/Netflix disappoint.
calls.quote: We have an oversold setup at a really strong support range at 700... I could see why there this could be an attractive dip by opportunity.

calls.reason: Risk/reward not worth it: 28% downside to 104 lows vs 19% upside to highs; loses ~$8B/yr, fair value 11.7% lower.
calls.quote: Risk to reward, in my opinion, just isn't worth it

calls.reason: Cheap-ish fundamentally and attractive long-term, but poor earnings-reaction track record and stagnant momentum; may get worse first.
calls.quote: I like the idea of investing into Netflix knowing that it can get worse before it gets better.

calls.reason: Small intraday overbought-reversal short, but says going long makes more sense; still oversold with ~22% recovery potential to highs.
calls.quote: I do have an open short on Micron... I still think it makes more sense to go long than it does to go short.

notes: Date from "SpaceX and Netflix report today" + "happy Tuesday" -> 2026-10-20. "700" support assumed SPY. SpaceX bias inferred from risk/reward comment (no explicit short). MU short is intraday only.
